title: Open-cover restriction and tensor pullback comparison
statement: For a scheme morphism p:Y→X [def-pc-scheme], an open cover U of X, and its member a, define the natural isomorphism between restriction to U_a followed by ordinary pullback along the base-changed chart map and tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along p followed by restriction to its pulled-back chart. Construct it by ordinary pullback composition, the chart commutativity equation, and uniqueness of the left adjoint to pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].
